faq.q: What do I need to play Hordes of Azeroth?
faq.a: Your own World of Warcraft 1.12.1 client files, build 5875, English enUS, in a folder kept for Hordes, plus about 3 GB of free disk space. The project does not include the WoW client.

faq.q: Where do I download the launcher?
faq.a: From the author's GitHub Releases page: HoALauncher.exe for Windows or HoALauncher-linux.tar.gz for Linux and Steam Deck. A similarly named website is not the author's.

faq.q: Does Hordes of Azeroth run on Mac?
faq.a: The author lists Mac as unsupported. One public Apple Silicon report uses Wine and describes three separate failures, so treat it as a bounded workaround rather than a supported route.

faq.q: Can I play Hordes of Azeroth with friends?
faq.a: Version 0.6.4 documents up to four players: a host opens a game from the character screen and others join from the game browser or by code. Hardcore characters are excluded from co-op.

faq.q: Is Hordes of Azeroth the same as Azeroth Survivors?
faq.a: No. Hordes of Azeroth is jonhaldors's local-client project for WoW 1.12.1; Azeroth Survivors is Aethus's separate browser game. Their setup and saves do not transfer.

faq.q: Why does the database fail to start during installation?
faq.a: Reported causes differ by stage, so match the exact message first and keep existing progress before changing files.
